raw_response:
This is my only plot of 0.64 hectares, so I must make sure the maize does well to feed my family. I was able to get two bags of fertilizer through the FISP program this year, which I will spread across the whole plot, and I also received hybrid seed that gives better yields than local maize. I will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting myself with help from my children, but I will hire about ten days of ganyu labor when the ridging and planting must be done quickly after the rains start. We do not irrigate here in Balaka as we rely entirely on the November rains, and I do not use chemicals on maize because they are too expensive and not needed for this crop.
